## Orientation Week

The orientation lasted for three days. There were many fun activities and informative events.

On day one, we got to know about our faculty and also played a bingo game, which allowed students to interact with each other.

The next day, we had some activities and got to meet a few of the cohort alumni, who shared their insights with us.

The last day was focused on a dinner party where we were served many delicious dishes. Although we felt a little sad that this period was over, it gave us huge confidence for the future!
